Plot {2}{R} (You may pay {2}{R} and exile this card from your hand. Cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Spider Food

cards.name: Entourage of Trest
cards.oracleText:

This creature can block an additional creature each combat as long as you're the monarch.

cards.name: Coming Attraction
